name: Projectile Step Tracker
instruction: Make the projectile advance the Shoot Em Up quest by calling QuestManager.progress_quest with the kill step each time it overlaps an enemy, queue_free itself after the hit, and ensure it also removes itself when it travels far off screen (50 pixels).

metadata.tutorial_source: YouTube: Chevifier - Quest Manager For Godot 4
metadata.transcript_excerpt: in order to progress the quest you need to call progress Quest ... in my projectiles node ... if the projectile overlapped with if it's an enemy I progress Quest ... it's killing one enemy ... and then it removes itself ... and that's just a check for if it's far off screen

key_properties.Projectile.script: Calls QuestManager.progress_quest("Shoot Em Up", "kill_step") on enemy overlap
